name: blueberry
description: Discord Bot with a bunch of utilities, I think.

scripts.start: concurrently -n bot,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm run bot" "pnpm --filter @blueberry/api run start" "pnpm --filter @blueberry/web run start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n bot,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm run bot:dev" "pnpm --filter @blueberry/api run dev" "pnpm --filter @blueberry/web run dev"
scripts.dashboard: concurrently -n api,web -c green,magenta "pnpm --filter @blueberry/api run dev" "pnpm --filter @blueberry/web run dev"

author: gaxolotl
